storyCards.headline: 1 2 3: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Gloria Estefan's "1 2 3" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. Gloria María Milagrosa Estefan (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈɡloɾja esˈtefan]; née Fajardo García; born September 1, 1957) is a Cuban-American singer, songwriter, actress, and businesswoman.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

1 2 3 was released in 1988.
